pkgmetadata.longdescription: DNF5 is a command-line package manager that automates the process of installing, upgrading, configuring, and removing computer programs in a consistent manner. It supports RPM packages, modulemd modules, and comps groups and environments. This is the next-generation version of DNF with improved performance and features.

use.flag: Enable support for comps (package groups and environments)
Enable zchunk compression support for repository metadata
